description.zh:
实例ID。 
> 如果是分片集群实例，您还需要配置`NodeId`。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the `NodeId` parameter.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > - 必须晚于查询开始时间。 > - 查询结束时间距查询开始时间不得超过24个小时，超过则调用失败。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

>

- The end time must be later than the start time.

- The end time must be within 24 hours from the start time. Otherwise, the query fails.

description.zh: 关键字搜索的逻辑操作， 默认值为and。
description.en:
The logical relationship among multiple keywords.

- **or**

- **and** (default value)

description.zh:
Shard节点ID。 

> 如果`DBInstanceId`配置的是分片集群实例的ID，需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the shard node.

> This parameter is required only when you specify the `DBInstanceId` parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

description.zh:
按时间的升降序对查询到的慢日志进行排序。取值如下：
- asc：按时间升序排序。
- desc：按时间降序排序。
description.en:
The order of time in which the log entries to return are sorted. Valid values:

- asc: The log entries are sorted by time in ascending order.

- desc: The log entries are sorted by time in descending order.

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number of the page to return. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30** to **100**.

description.zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字。
description.en: The keywords used for query. You can enter up to 10 keywords at a time. If you enter multiple keywords, separate the keywords with spaces.
The ID of the resource group to which the instances you want to query belong.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 查询实例运行出现的慢操作日志明细

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口仅适用于规格类型为**通用型本地盘版**,**独享型本地盘版**和**独享型云盘版**实例。
- 本接口限制每分钟调用30次，如超过这个限制会被限流，请勿高频调用。如需高频调用，请使用Logstore，详情请参见[管理Logstore](~~48990~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is applicable only to **general-purpose local-disk** and **dedicated local-disk** instances.

- You can call this operation up to 30 times per minute. To call this operation at a higher frequency, use a Logstore. For more information, see [Manage a Logstore](~~48990~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-slow-log-records --db-instance-id dds-bp1fc7e651080000 --node-id d-bp18b06ebc210000 --start-time 2021-08-15T14:13Z --end-time 2021-08-16T14:13Z --db-name mongodbtest --query-keywords test_test1 --logical-operator and --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeSlowLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --OrderType asc --EndTime '2021-08-16T14:13Z' --QueryKeywords test_test1 --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp1fc7e651080000' --PageNumber 1 --LogicalOperator and --NodeId 'd-bp18b06ebc210000' --StartTime '2021-08-15T14:13Z' --DBName mongodbtest
